invariants.rationale: The method is likely to require a non-null HoodieWriteConfig to function properly, and downstream method calls would expect config to be initialized.
A non-null StorageConfiguration is necessary for most table creation logic, as it configures storage details.
If skipValidation is false (i.e., validation is not skipped), then config must be non-null for validation to proceed.
If skipValidation is false, some validation of the storage configuration may take place, which would require storageConf to be non-null.
